title: Fairy's a pretty cool dude
post: To the people upset aabout fairy, can I genuinely ask -- why? This is a guy that's made it his life mission to help people down on their luck. Plus he's a total bro. Down to talk about emotional issues most guys tend to skirt around. And he's funny too! Not too mantion his an amazing sense of style, which of course is something most other guys tend to neglect. But nah he's down to talk about chill stuff in a positive, non toxic way, and helps people for no benefit but yeah f**k him I guess??
author: FriendOfFairy
